scripts.setup: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && npm run setup:api && npm run setup:web && npm install
scripts.setup:api: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.check: npm run check:secrets && npm run check:api && npm run check:web
scripts.check:api: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python -m ruff check . && .venv\Scripts\python -m ruff format --check . && .venv\Scripts\python -m pytest -q
